thread:
maya: Quick sync — EU-central deployment milestone check. We're aiming for a soft-launch next Wed. Need clear owners for routing policy, KMS provisioning, certs, and legal/data-residency signoff. cc @sam @lina

sam: I can take routing policy + the test harness. Question: do we prefer intra-EU fallback (gcp-eu) or fallback to us-west for bursts? Also who's on-call for routing rollbacks?

lina: For compliance customers we should prefer intra-EU fallback. For general traffic, prefer eu->eu then us as last resort. I'll handle rollout coordination and cost approvals.

omar: SRE notes: we'll need DNS names, cert SAN updates, and IAM access for KMS. Also we need quota increase tickets for the new LB. Who's owning KMS?

jen: Security: Aisha will handle key creation but needs to know if we require cross-region replicas. Legal also needs the data residency doc before prod.

aisha: I can do key provisioning. Prefer single primary in eu-central, replicate logs to our auditor. If Legal insists on geo-redundant keys we'll need additional controls.

maya: OK assigning owners: Sam = routing policy & test harness, Aisha = KMS provisioning, Omar = SRE infra + DNS/certs, Lina = rollout & cost, Jen = security signoff; Legal = TBD. Any blockers?

platform-bot: deploy-checklist: infra OK for eu-central? Outstanding tasks: certs, kms, dns, loadbalancer quota, and service-account IAM.

sam: One technical blocker: eng-ml needs to publish the eu container image with the quantized model variant. @eng-ml can you confirm ETA?

lina: I'll ping finance for cross-region burst budget. Ballpark extra monthly cost ~ $4.2k.

omar: I'll open the infra PR for LB and DNS now and tag reviewers. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/488

jen: Legal needs the data map and risk notes. @maya can you drop the doc in #eng-legal or share link? We also need SOC2 note attached.

maya: Added data map here: https://redwood.internal/docs/eu-data-map — please review, I'll update when Legal responds.

sam: After KMS and certs are in prod, can someone run an end-to-end canary? I'll schedule canary tests next Tue.

aisha: KMS keys provisioned in staging. KMS ARN (redacted): arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:REDACTED:key/abcd-1234.

omar: Certs deployed to staging, waiting on prod KMS role to finish.

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll mark 'owners assigned' and update the milestone in Jira RDW-1256 unless there are objections. :thumbsup:

lina: No objections. :thumbsup:

platform-bot: jira-update: RDW-1256 updated -> owners assigned

maya: Follow-ups: Sam to post routing policy snippet in this thread; Omar to link PR; Aisha to post KMS prod ARN once ready; Jen/legal to confirm data residency doc. We'll do another async check-in in 48h.

sam: Posting routing policy draft:
```
route_preference:
  - eu-primary
  - eu-fallback
  - global-fallback
circuit_breakers:
  - threshold: 90% capacity
    action: failover-to-eu-fallback
```

lina: Noted. I'll keep finance in the loop. :eyes:

aisha: Prod KMS role created; will post ARN after prod IAM ticket closes.

omar: PR opened and linked in RDW-1256. CC @sam for review.

maya: Great — closing this check-in. If anything blocks your tasks, ping here or @eng-platform.
